verdict.rationale: Microsoft documents an official Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit CLI for the Teams platform, with feature parity to the IDE extensions. It covers creating agents and apps from templates, previewing them in Teams, provisioning and deploying to Azure, and validating, packaging and publishing. The CLI's scope is app development rather than operating Teams itself, and nothing shows agent-oriented affordances. missing for 10: CLI commands for core Teams operations (messages, channels, teams), evidence of machine-friendly/agent-oriented CLI output, independent or hands-on corroboration.
